Demo Blender BX-200 Owner's Manual

Safety
Always unplug the blender before cleaning the blades. Never run the blender motor empty for more than 10 seconds.

Cleaning
Fill the jar halfway with warm water and a drop of dish soap, then run on low speed for 30 seconds. Rinse and dry.

Limited warranty
The blender motor base is covered by a limited warranty for two years from the date of purchase against defects in materials and workmanship. Keep your receipt as proof of purchase.

Troubleshooting
If the blender does not start, check that the jar is locked onto the motor base and the plug is seated firmly.
